我的生活与购物(My Life and shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的A2短文:利奥与汤姆的经历和小计划。
Last Monday, Leo and Tom went to the book store. Leo and Tom had great fun there. They took many photos at the discount area. The small town became prosperous after the new road opened.
Both of them like noodles and milk. Leo thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Tom is interested in drawing. Best of all, pay by credit card if you like.
Leo is reading a book about science. Leo bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Leo learned a lot about science. What's more, consumers want cheaper and better products.
Leo wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the book store by bike. Leo wants to be a cook in the future.
